content:
Hey, does protected not work in modules?

module
protected def Foo.bar := 42
open Foo
/-- info: Foo.bar : Nat -/
#guard_msgs in
#check bar

protected def Foo.bar := 42
open Foo
/-- error: Unknown identifier `bar` -/
#guard_msgs in
#check bar

I tried looking in the Lean Language Reference and I didn't see it mentioned in the sections that describe protected. FWIW I also went back to v4.29.0 to see if it's a regression, but it also didn't work there.
This has nothing to do with the module system; private protected doesn't work; that's the problem
It should probably be rejected then, feel free to open an issue (if there isn't one yet)

Why should it be rejected? I feel it should just work and I think

diff --git a/src/Lean/ResolveName.lean b/src/Lean/ResolveName.lean
index b687cc6b3c..ecec928fe5 100644
--- a/src/Lean/ResolveName.lean
+++ b/src/Lean/ResolveName.lean
@@ -139,7 +139,8 @@ private def resolveQualifiedName (env : Environment) (opts : Options) (ns : Name
     if containsDeclOrReserved env resolvedId then
       return resolvedId :: resolvedIds
     else if let some resolvedIdPrv := resolvePrivateName env opts resolvedId then
-      return resolvedIdPrv :: resolvedIds
+      if !id.isAtomic || !isProtected env resolvedIdPrv then
+        return resolvedIdPrv :: resolvedIds
   return resolvedIds

 /-- Check surrounding namespaces -/

would just fix it
